Title: Uncertainty-Aware Pseudo-Label Filtering for Source-Free Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
Takeaway: Our Uncertainty-aware Pseudo-label-filtering Adaptation (UPA) method effectively filters noisy pseudo labels in source-free unsupervised domain adaptation, achieving competitive performance on par with state-of-the-art methods.
Authors: Xi Chen, Haosen Yang, Huicong Zhang, Hongxun Yao, Xiatian Zhu

Title: A Comprehensive Survey on Test-Time Adaptation Under Distribution Shifts
Takeaway: Test-time adaptation (TTA) improves machine learning performance by adapting pre-trained models to unlabeled data during testing, overcoming distribution shifts.
Authors: Jian Liang, R. He, Tien-Ping Tan
